{{Quote|Our delectable, fluffy omelets are prepared to your request. Enjoy our basic omelet, made from three Grade Aurek garto eggs and filled with shredded jerba cheese, or add any of these favorite ingredients for a small charge: diced gornt, diced roba, Felucian glasscap mushrooms, Ferroan spinach, Bellassan peppers, Ojomian onions, topatoes or calarantrum root.|Dex's Diner menu, on its gartro egg omelet|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Diced roba''' was an ingredient that consisted of the diced meat of a [[Roba/Legends|roba]],<ref name="Menu" /> a type of tusked [[Porcine/Legends|porcine]] creature.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'' Second Edition]]</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], sold diced roba and scrambled [[gartro egg]]s as a [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate]] breakfast specials for 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner also offered diced roba as an additive to its [[gartro egg omelet]]tes at an additional cost of five [[Decicred/Legends|decicreds]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Diced roba was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
